arcs.name: Umbrella
arcs.desc: Remember to get enough sleep and check the weather forecast; remember to eat your meals and take an umbrella when going out.

arcs.name: Cosmos Daze, Wild Reverie
arcs.desc: Masterpiece from Pop Re-Creator!

arcs.name: Good Boy's Grand Adventure
arcs.desc: What do you see? A winged white wolf? An adorable white dog? Or perhaps…?

arcs.name: Shiny Days
arcs.desc: Capturing these radiant moments, even in dreams they must go on. Regret was never beautiful, and you were never alone.

arcs.name: The Forgotten
arcs.desc: Even if I'm just a complement to those masterpieces… I'm still beautiful too, right?

arcs.name: Camellia Society
arcs.desc: Though I'm not supposed to let my composure slip onto the petals… that flower really cut deep.

arcs.name: Oraora!
arcs.desc: It's said that in a faraway place, Ora Puncher has a cousin, Muda Puncher.

arcs.name: Mind Royale
arcs.desc: Inspiration is like potato chips—crunching and crackling, leaving scattered crumbs everywhere, without rhyme or reason.

arcs.name: Day Off
arcs.desc:
Eclipse said, "Let there be double days off."
And thus, the double days off came into being (Eclipse Exclusive Edition).

arcs.name: Dangerous Game
arcs.desc: Let's make a bet. Loser goes broke.

arcs.name: First Step to Success
arcs.desc: Good self-control is the first step on the road to success.

arcs.name: Be Happy
arcs.desc: Hm? Why aren't you laughing?

arcs.name: Us.
arcs.desc: I am… you… are… you, are… it, is… me… no, I… am… us.

arcs.name: The Good, The Bad, The Bitter
arcs.desc: A touch of bitterness, but it'll still put you in a good mood, won't it?

arcs.name: "Real Music"
arcs.desc: Waddaya mean ya prefer "real music"? Is this not "real" enough for yer taste?

arcs.name: Ready-Ready
arcs.desc: Hold me close, embrace the courage and resolve that transcends the fallen—I salute you, great Tiger warriors.

arcs.name: Blow up the Crowd
arcs.desc: Shh… it's coming, it's coming! IT'S COMING!!!

arcs.name: Youthful Fantasy
arcs.desc: "Secret"… The moment it was recorded, it was already known by everyone.

arcs.name: Contemplative Cat
arcs.desc: The meaning of life… the reason for existence… the answer to the universe is… 4… balls of yarn!

arcs.name: Your Happiness is Priceless
arcs.desc: Mm, mm-hmm, mm-hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm! (Give me Fons— You'll be happy, and I'll be happy too!)

arcs.name: Raging Flames
arcs.desc: The desire for speed flows through my veins, the roar of engines thunders in my chest! Come on, let's go! Step onto this racetrack where we pledge our souls!

arcs.name: Eternal Waltz
arcs.desc: Dance to the beat, feel the dizzying sensation as if the world is ending, until forever!

arcs.name: Hethereau's Keeper
arcs.desc: Once again, another day has passed peacefully. Hats off to Officer Whisker!

arcs.name: The Great Thief
arcs.desc: The moment I saw you, I was captivated. Your soft fur, that mischievous look on your face—I was mesmerized for so long that it wasn't until you left that I realized… where are my grilled skewers?

arcs.name: Watch Your Heads!
arcs.desc: Hehehe… Don't be scared, it's just a laughing kite…

arcs.name: Clear Skies
arcs.desc: Formation complete, securing air superiority.

arcs.name: Failing You, Heavy in My Heart
arcs.desc: When you see red reflected in your teacher's eyes, that usually means you're about to fail the class.

arcs.name: Drawn Blade
arcs.desc: Lone moon, dark clouds. Blade drawn, soul departs. Form fades, blade weeps.

arcs.name: A Time Will Come
arcs.desc: Descending from the heavens, returning to the heavens. Believing in that destined day, we leap into this endless migration with no visible end.

arcs.name: The Fools' Spring
arcs.desc: If I were a cicada, I'd still sing with my raspy voice.

arcs.name: Fluff of Fortitude
arcs.desc: Hunter Guild Commemorative Arc: So fluffy!

arcs.name: Fluff of Ferocity
arcs.desc: Hunter Guild Commemorative Arc: Discard all that is useless…

arcs.name: Fluff of Finesse
arcs.desc: Hunter Guild Commemorative Arc: Not every encounter is a pleasant one…

arcs.name: Fluff of Fleetness
arcs.desc: Hunter Guild Commemorative Arc: MAD FLUFF!

arcs.name: Fluff of Fearlessness
arcs.desc: Hunter Guild Commemorative Arc: Cool fluffs don't look at explosions.

arcs.name: Time Bandit
arcs.desc: Time is like water next to a sponge. Look away for only a second, and it vanishes.

arcs.name: Call of the Twisted City
arcs.desc: When the world begins to warp, crying out in ways no one can understand, who among us can hold on to their sanity?

arcs.name: Reality Refuge
arcs.desc: She told me that I was only ever a butterfly.

arcs.name: Tears Beneath the Mask
arcs.desc: Who stole my child? Was it you? Was it him? Or was it…

arcs.name: Song of the Whale
arcs.desc: The surging tide is its final farewell.

arcs.name: Marching Beyond Time
arcs.desc: We press on, lest we rust away to nothing.

arcs.name: The Last Rose
arcs.desc: On the water's surface, the last rose blooms alone. She waits… for a dear friend, or perhaps for a boundless dream.

arcs.name: The Rain That Shook the World
arcs.desc: It emerged from a downpour that turned the world upside down.

arcs.name: Stellar Veil
arcs.desc: At sunrise, the lost stars are merely homeward bound.

arcs.name: What's Desired
arcs.desc: And so the epic begins, and everyone sets out on the journey. As for where the road ends, does it really matter?

arcs.name: Blushing Mirage
arcs.desc: Moonlight whispers a promise of unfurled wings, stirring rare passion and inspiration. But not every whisper should be trusted.

arcs.name: The Wrong Gate
arcs.desc: Do not open that door. Do not leave this place. Wouldn't you rather stay somewhere warm?

arcs.name: Ravenous Blade
arcs.desc: Where fear takes hold, death is never far behind.

arcs.name: Voice of the Voyager
arcs.desc: The languages engraved upon it remain indecipherable. Yet their message is clear enough: somewhere in the cosmos, we are not alone.
